answers.reason: The chancellor is not mentioned as a member of the senate.
The chancellor heads the central administration and is responsible for the budget and staff.
The chancellor's remit is administration and budget, not individual examination matters.
The chancellor does not deal with module revisions for specific degree programmes.
The chancellor does not choose laboratory equipment for teaching laboratories.
The chancellor is part of the central administration and not a member of a specific faculty council.
The chancellor does not prepare degree programme changes in faculty study commissions.
The chancellor does not award small internal grants for research projects in faculties.
The chancellor does not plan orientation weeks for new students.
The chancellor is not a member of appointment committees selecting professorship candidates.
